properties.displayName: CCC.ObjStor.CN02 - Storage accounts must disable shared key access
properties.description: Audits storage accounts that still allow account-key (shared key) authorization instead of Entra ID identity-based access. Maps to FINOS CCC ObjStor CN02 (Prevent Anonymous or Public Access to Buckets and Objects) and enforces the AVM storage-account sample settings 'shared_access_key_enabled = false' and 'default_to_oauth_authentication = true'.

metadata.ccc_title: Prevent Anonymous or Public Access to Buckets and Objects

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of the policy.
